name: Appointment Date — User Omits Year, Bot Prompts for Year
goal: User provides appointment date without year; bot prompts for year and resolves date.
constraints: User says '15 March' as appointment date, bot must ask for year before proceeding.

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option; user chooses to book.
Bot asks for coverage type; user selects 'Only Spouse'.
Bot collects spouse details; user provides valid name and DOB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name and DOB.

phases.description: User provides appointment date without year.
User provides year; bot resolves and stores full date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot stores date in DD MMM YYYY format and proceeds.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
